match.verdict: Strong delivery and stakeholder fit, light on cloud cost tooling.

candidate.name: Alex Sample
candidate.headline: Technology Delivery Lead | Cloud Migration | Agile at Scale

summary: Delivery lead with ten years running multi-team cloud programmes for banks and insurers. Comfortable owning the plan, the budget and the awkward conversations with stakeholders. Looking to bring that to a platform engineering role.

bullets: Led a 40 person migration of 120 applications to AWS across three regions.
Cut release cycle from monthly to weekly by introducing trunk based development.

highlights: Migration leadership at scale, 120 applications moved to AWS.

howToCater: Reframe the budget tracking you did on the AWS migration as cost governance.
Take the FinOps Certified Practitioner course, about 10 hours.
gaps.evidenceInCv: Tracked a 1.2M budget across the AWS migration.
reframedWording: Owned budget tracking and forecasting for a 1.2M cloud migration, flagging overspend risks to programme sponsors.
addIfTrue: Reduced monthly cloud spend by [percent] by [action, for example rightsizing or reserved instances].
Set up [tool] dashboards so [number] teams could see their own cloud costs.
